learningObjective.zh: 學習及練習與 GET 有關的片語動詞。
learningObjective.en: Learn and practise the phrasal verbs related to GET.

register.labelZh: GET (VOLUME 1) 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: get over、get past 和 get out 可以描述前往某地、越過狹窄位置,以及安全離開某個地方。；get over 可以描述從疾病或失望中恢復,也可以表示克服恐懼或害羞。；你可以用 GET 表達請水喉匠前來、送孩子上學、請教練回來,或介紹某人使用實用的應用程式。；get round to 表示拖延後終於做某事;get round something 則表示避開或處理障礙。
register.summaryEn: Get over, get past and get out help you describe travelling somewhere, moving through a narrow space and leaving a place safely. Get over can describe recovering from an illness or disappointment, as well as overcoming fear or shyness. You can get a plumber in, get the children off to school, get a coach back or get somebody onto a useful app. Get round to shows that you finally do something after a delay. Get round something shows that you avoid or deal with an obstacle.
contextsZh: 使用 GET 清楚描述旅程和移動
運用 GET 處理日常安排
表達延遲處理的事情和無法迴避的問題
contextsEn: Use GET to describe travel and movement clearly
Talk naturally about recovery and confidence
Handle everyday arrangements with useful GET expressions
Express delayed tasks and unavoidable problems
register.formalZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 GET 片語動詞。
register.formalEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the GET expression that gives the same meaning.
